reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but shares predicates rather than the complete occurrence handling policy.

duplication.why: Daily filtering and conditional date adjustment are repeated across next-date lookup, upcoming dates, range dates, and budget counting.

placement.why: Calendar primitives belong in shared/schedules and handler registration follows existing conventions, although scheduling policy remains scattered into server consumers.

scope.why: All edits support the requested daily skipping, range handler, holiday handling, or their tests.

maintainability.why: Shared holiday matching simplifies future changes, but repeated policy orchestration and separate search-window calculations require coordinated maintenance.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts requests raw dates from getNextDate and reapplies adjustment policy, while getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently orchestrate filtering and adjustment around RSchedule.

disguised_duplication.where: shared/schedules.ts expresses daily selection through candidates.find and subsequent adjustment, while schedules/app.ts reshapes the same policy into filter/map pipelines and schedule-template.ts into conditional raw lookups followed by adjustment.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-skipping special case; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and both budget lookup/adjustment sites retain independent policy orchestration.
